account-locked: Yaalii seensaa kufaa baay’ee irraa kan ka’e herregichi yeroo muraasaaf cufameera. Maaloo booda irra deebi’ii yaali.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel SuperAdmin qofaaf, Domeena Cloud Panel irratti.
cloud-settings-desc: WeKan Weddy keessaa wajjin, Cloud Panel sarvarii tokko irraa domeenota WeKan baay'ee tajaajila, tokkoon tokkoon isaanii daataa mataa isaanii qabu. Domeena Cloud Panel irratti, SuperAdmin domeenotaa fi CloudFlare bulcha.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Furtuu CloudFlare API waliin, domeenni zoonii isaa herrega CloudFlare keessan keessa jiru galmee DNS proxy godhame fi ragaa CloudFlare Origin argata. Domeenonni biroo ragaa Let's Encrypt argatu. Furtuun sarvarii irratti olkaa'ama, lammata hin mul'atu.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Furtuun CloudFlare API kamiyyuu hin olkaa'amne: domeenni hundi ragaa Let's Encrypt argata.
error-notAuthorized: Fuula kana ilaaluuf hayyama hin qabdu.
